summary: Iteration 8 testing complete - Unified Approvals, Public Apply Pages, Country Economics, Admin Sidebar Reorganization. All 28 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: Admin sidebar reorganized to 3 groups (Platform ops, Insights, Configuration), Approvals inbox with 4 tabs and drawer, /apply/reseller and /apply/institution public pages, Country Hub as TABLE format, Country Detail with 6 tabs including Economics, Settings Hub with humanized keys and reorganized groups.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/admin/approvals/inbox returns {sender_ids, wa_templates, reseller_applications, institution_applications, total} with requester_email/name enrichment
POST /api/public/apply/reseller accepts application, rejects if agree_terms=false, dedupes on email+pending
POST /api/public/apply/institution similar flow, writes to db.institution_applications
POST /api/admin/applications/resellers/{id}/review - approve creates reseller user with temp password and reseller_code
POST /api/admin/applications/institutions/{id}/review - approve promotes to db.institutions collection

GET /api/admin/country-hub/{code}/economics returns unit_economics (usd_per_credit, credits_per_sms, retail_usd_per_sms, cost_usd_per_sms_min/max/avg, margin_usd_per_sms, margin_pct, providers_count) and windows (1/7/30/90 days P&L)
economy.usd_per_credit setting exists (default 0.01) and is editable via PUT /admin/settings
Admin sidebar reorganized: Platform ops (Users, Resellers, Institutions, Approvals), Insights (Overview, Margin & revenue, Audit logs), Configuration (Settings hub)
Old nav items (Campaigns, Routing, Providers, Countries, Pricing, CreditPacks, Promotions, Prefixes, CountryHub, Integrations, WhatsApp) NOT in admin sidebar - accessible via Settings Hub
Settings Hub Geographies group contains: country_hub, integrations, routing, providers, prefixes, countries, pricing
Settings Hub Economy group contains: credits, pricing_cfg, credit_packs, referrals, streaks
Settings keys humanized (e.g., 'Credits default rate' not 'credits.default_rate')
seed_data_creation: Reseller and institution applications created during testing for approval flow verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 complete.
